document_title: Measures for the Management of Municipal Solid Waste
clause_text:
Organizations and individuals shall deposit municipal solid waste in designated containers or collection sites in accordance with the prescribed locations, times, and other requirements.
Bulky waste, such as discarded furniture, shall be deposited at designated collection sites at the prescribed times.
In areas with separate collection of municipal solid waste, organizations and individuals shall place waste in the appropriate bags and deposit it in designated containers or collection sites in accordance with the prescribed sorting requirements.
Hotels, restaurants, catering establishments, government bodies, educational institutions, and other organizations shall separately collect and store the food waste they generate, and entrust municipal solid waste collection and transport enterprises meeting these Measures to transport it to designated treatment sites.
Indiscriminate dumping, scattering, or stockpiling of municipal solid waste is prohibited.

document_title: Wuhan Municipal Measures for Municipal Solid Waste Classification
clause_text: Persons responsible for managing municipal solid waste sorting and disposal shall perform the following duties: (1) provide sorting containers or collection points as prescribed and keep the containers intact and functional; (2) conduct publicity, guide and supervise organizations and individuals in waste sorting, and advise against and stop non-compliant disposal; (3) consolidate sorted waste for storage at locations meeting collection, transport, and environmental control requirements, or transfer it to qualified enterprises for separate collection and transport; and (4) establish a daily waste sorting management system and a management ledger recording the categories, quantities, and destinations of waste generated within the area of responsibility.

document_title: Wuhan Municipal Regulations on Urban Park Management
clause_text:
The municipal landscaping authority is responsible for sectoral management, professional guidance, and supervision of parks within the urban planning area.
Park management organizations are responsible for routine park management.
